segments.deltaLabel: ALL SHARE INDEX · WEEK TO DATE
segments.say: Your Zimbabwe Stock Exchange weekly breakdown. Four sessions in, and the market is in the red.

segments.title: All Share Index
segments.say: The All Share Index ended last week at 499.40 points. By Thursday's close it was at 491.81. That's down 1.52 percent in just four sessions.

segments.title: Biggest gainers
segments.sub: Thursday 19 Nov session · price in ZWG
segments.say: Thursday's top gainer was CBZ Holdings, up 14.18 percent. African Distillers added 5.25 percent.

segments.title: Biggest fallers
segments.sub: Thursday 19 Nov session · price in ZWG
segments.say: RioZim fell 14.63 percent, ZSE Holdings 10.76, and Rainbow Tourism 10.53. Heavyweight Delta slipped 4.12 percent.

segments.title: Where the money went
segments.say: Follow the money: ZSE Holdings was the most traded counter, with about 7.4 million Zimbabwe gold changing hands, more than double Delta.

segments.title: One-year change
segments.label: ALL SHARE INDEX
notes: Thursday's close is 2.1% below the 52-week high
segments.source: AfricanFinancials, ZSE All Share Index, 19 Nov 2026
segments.say: Over twelve months, the All Share Index is up 128 percent, and it sits just 2 percent below its 52-week high.

segments.title: 2026 so far
segments.say: This year's stars: Tanganda, up over 640 percent, and TN CyberTech, up over 620. Rainbow Tourism is down 41 percent.

segments.title: What to watch
lines: Friday decides the week: the index needs about +1.5% to finish flat
Q3 updates out from RioZim, Rainbow Tourism and Zeco
